recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Reopening FHIR-11109 would duplicate later Device.name work and could conflict with subsequent published decisions; future changes should use a newer Device-name tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-11109 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request raised against DSTU2 Device asking for an element to capture the device name and its type. The recorded resolution first discussed a Device DI element and cleanup of DI references from Device.type, then reopened with a 2017-02-05 9-0-1 vote to apply the attached UDI/device presentation; the Jira related section is Device.name.
initial_application: Historical application is visible in the 2017-02-07 batch commits 2bd8c956, 05a86527, and d9163a93 labelled [#11105]-[#11109], [11050], [11049]. Those commits changed Device spreadsheet source, UDI examples, Device notes, and fhir.ini, including moving UDI-DI material out of Device.type and adding Device name/UDI-name content. Later source refactors replaced that spreadsheet source with StructureDefinition XML and terminology files.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml and related terminology files are current build inputs. Current Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier captures the UDI-DI concept, and current Device.name is a repeatable backbone with value and type subelements. Later published work refined the same area: FHIR-20639 improved Device.name.type definitions, FHIR-39162 reworked Device.deviceName into Device.name and added Device.name.display, and FHIR-47605 context explains the commercial-brand-family name type now visible in source. Community searches found no FHIR-11109-specific conflict.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Device source already contains the requested device name plus name type structure and preserves UDI-DI as Device.udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier, consistent with later approved Device-name refinements.
